scripts.test: npm run test:rules && npm run test:reminders && npm run test:e2e
scripts.test:rules: cp ../firebase.json ../firestore.rules . && firebase emulators:exec --only firestore --project demo-events "node rules.test.mjs firestore.rules"
scripts.test:reminders: cp ../firebase.json ../firestore.rules . && firebase emulators:exec --only firestore --project demo-events "node reminders.test.mjs"
scripts.test:e2e: cp ../firebase.json ../firestore.rules . && EVENTS_ROOT=.. TZ=America/New_York firebase emulators:exec --only firestore,auth --project demo-events "node e2e.mjs"
